Title: Cyrena.Angular - AngularShortcut (IShortcut)
Summary: IShortcut implementation for creating Angular development conversations. No configuration dialog — creates chat immediately with builder ID 'angular' and navigates to converse.
Content:
## AngularShortcut

**Namespace:** `Cyrena.Angular.Models`
**Assembly:** `Cyrena.Angular`

### Purpose
`IShortcut` implementation that creates a new Angular development conversation when clicked. No configuration dialog — creates the chat immediately and navigates to the conversation.

### Class Definition

```csharp
internal class AngularShortcut : IShortcut
{
    public AngularShortcut(DialogService dialog, IKernelController kernel, NavigationManager nav);
    
    public string Title => "Angular";
    public string Description => "Develop an Angular application";
    public string Icon => "bi bi-box";
    public string Color => "danger";
    public string Category => "Web";
    public string[] Tags => ["TypeScript", "Web", "Frontend"];
    
    public async Task OnClick();
}
```

### OnClick Behavior
1. Creates a new `ChatConfiguration` with:
   - `Id = Guid.NewGuid().ToString()`
   - `AssistantModeId = DevelopOptions.AssistantModeId` ( `"developer"` )
   - `DevelopOptions.BuilderId = AngularOptions.BuilderId` ( `"angular"` )
   - `ChatConfiguration.Icon = "bi bi-box"`
   - `ChatConfiguration.Group = "Web"`
2. Calls `_kernel.Create(model)` to initialize the kernel
3. Navigates to `converse/{model.Id}`

### UI Properties
| Property | Value | Description |
|----------|-------|-------------|
| Title | `"Angular"` | Display name in shortcut grid |
| Description | `"Develop an Angular application"` | Subtitle text |
| Icon | `"bi bi-box"` | Bootstrap Icons class |
| Color | `"danger"` | Bootstrap color theme (red) |
| Category | `"Web"` | Grouping category |
| Tags | `["TypeScript", "Web", "Frontend"]` | Search/filter tags |

### Dependencies
- `DialogService` — Inherited from constructor but unused (no dialog shown)
- `IKernelController` — For creating the kernel instance
- `NavigationManager` — For navigating to the conversation page

### Registration
Registered via `CyrenaBuilderExtensions.AddAngular()`:
```csharp
builder.AddShortcut<AngularShortcut>();
```

### Related Types
- `CyrenaBuilderExtensions.AddAngular()` — Registers this shortcut
- `AngularBuilder` — `ICodeBuilder` loaded when this shortcut is clicked
- `AngularOptions.BuilderId` — `"angular"`
